entity_kinds.description: A CLI command or subcommand (e.g., `graph build`, `graph search`, Cmd+K).
An environment variable, file, or setting required to run a command (e.g., XIAOMI_API_KEY, .env file).
A software component, model, or library used by the system (e.g., LLM model, SQLite, FTS5).
A repository or type of content that can be searched (e.g., git log, code, documents).

predicates.description: A command needs a configuration value or file to function.
A command or system component employs a tool, model, or library.
A command queries one or more data sources to retrieve results.
A configuration value is supplied by a specific tool or environment.
